principles: Preserve literal reported quantities and source-specific dates.
Multi-source tracing: finished product → ingredient → acquisition → container → POI/gate.
Do not infer a numerical drop probability from words like 常见, 大概率, 概率, 必出.
Make crafting alternatives and natural loot alternatives visible.
Keep contradictory stats side by side; never average or silently prefer.
A game release/date is metadata, not a reason to exclude its mechanics.

mechanical_rules.statement: Generator burns low-grade fuel; direct generator to appliance means always-on; optional manual/pressure/infrared switching allows conditional power; electric doors fail closed on power loss.
Correct access card AND active power both required for specific POI doors; improper sequence may consume card durability.
Airdrop on six-hour cycle, visible marker, can be opened after 10 minutes.
After starting a crafting job, player need not stay near Workbench.
Recycler located at named resource POIs, processes cans, blades, scrap to Parts; yield/item unspecified.

A 2020 field guide explicitly treats recycler of scavenged gears/pipes/blades as a route to Parts and some processed refined material, rather than mining alone; the article offers a 2 Parts/barrel anecdote, not a universal drop rate.
Connected foundation count determines multiplier; >=24 +30% up to >=48 +275% (reported).
Doors have approximately one third HP of same-tier wall; affects optimal access vs defense.
A found physical product can be sacrificed to draw a learnable blueprint; learned blueprint remains through death, while unlearned blueprint drops.
2019 Q&A: PvE mode 15 real days, PvP restriction lifted during late countdown (~71h remaining), distinct from permanent solo offline PvE.
Power/credential in POI and local Green→Blue→Purple cards create repeat-visit progression; a 3h card refresh is reported.
